paragraphs: LeagueApps sells a youth sports management platform that handles registration, payments, communications, scheduling, reporting, and facilities for the organizations that run programs. The platform is sold with a mobile app for team management and communication, and with custom WordPress websites built with a designer. Reporting is offered as a data and analytics product, with real-time reporting inside the platform.

The pages name the buyers by program type: clubs, camps, tournaments, leagues, and facilities. The about page describes the people being sold to as youth sports leaders, the owners, operators, and admins who run those programs. Case studies name customers such as Ripken Baseball, Gateway Field Hockey, Total Package Hockey, and Atlanta United Training Programs.

Support is described as onboarding assistance, answers to questions within 24 hours, and consultations about integrations. Customers get a free membership in NextUp, a community for youth sports management, and discounts on its conference tickets. The about page counts more than 3,000 youth and local sports organizations powered.

quote.text: LeagueApps is the only technology and community platform designed to power local and youth sports experiences, and support the leaders who make them happen.
